_note: Model list prices as read on the date below. Prices are real and public; everything they are applied to in this solution is synthetic. A company that uses this repository puts its own contract prices here, and nothing in the code changes.
eur_per_usd_basis: assumption; a company puts its own rate here
cache_read_note: Cache reads cost a fraction of the input price. The run records of this repository count cache reads inside the input total, so a cost computed from them is an upper bound. The ledger says so on every line it builds from those records.
